page.overview:
What is Gedyneith?

Gedyneith is a sacred oak tree within a grove located in the northeastern forests of Ard Skellig. Most druids live here, where they worship Freya and practice their crafts in peace.

It's northeast of the Abandoned Sawmill and southwest of the Whale Graveyard, and has two signposts located in the eastern and western sides of the grove.

The grove hosts a number of grottoes tunneled on the side of the hill where the tree stands to serve as dwellings for the druids. The place is also the headquarters of Skellige's hierophant.
